evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific step in the main flow where an alternative IU assumes reporting responsibility (R²) following a trigger of missed updates.

evidence_cards.content: A related TN for Impact Point will be used only by the C² JU with R² for the related missile track. Therefore a change in R² of the ballistic missile track also causes a change in R² for the related Impact Point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the automatic consequence of transferring R² for a parent track (missile track) to the child track (impact point), which is part of the transfer process sequence.

evidence_cards.content: A JU receiving a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, on a locally held track shall assume R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific trigger (J7.0 Drop Track) and immediate system response (assume R²) for the main flow of transferring reporting responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² for a nonreal-time track, i.e., TQ field set to value 0, shall assume R² for that track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative successful scenario where R² is assumed based on local update of a nonreal-time track, diverging from real-time or message-triggered flows.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ greater than local TQ.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a condition under which the current R² holder relinquishes responsibility — a key step in the main flow of transfer.

evidence_cards.content: After applying all the above rules, a JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose Source TN is greater than the local Source TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a tie-breaking rule for relinquishing R² when TQ values are equal, completing the decision logic for transfer in real-time tracks.

evidence_cards.content: A unit assuming R² for a ballistic missile track need not assume R² for the associated launch point. The unit no longer holding R² on the ballistic missile track may continue to report the launch point in accordance with the transmit/receive rules.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an exception or variant flow specific to ballistic missile tracks, where R² assumption does not extend to related entities (launch point), allowing partial retention of reporting duties.

evidence_cards.content: If changes in data are not accepted on tracks by the JU that is controlling the track, the controlling unit shall transmit its locally held data in a J7.0 (ACT = 1) message with the Controlling Unit Indicator field set.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a specific step in the main flow where the controlling unit actively responds to a rejected change order by re-transmitting its local data to assert control.

evidence_cards.content: In addition, if the controlling unit has R², it shall continue to transmit the locally held ID data in a J3.X message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies a concurrent action required during the transfer of reporting responsibility sequence when the unit holds R².

evidence_cards.content: If a J2 PPLI message is not received for 40 to 60 seconds, the C² JU shall assume R² of an IU in accordance with reporting rules for a real-time track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific time-based trigger condition within the main flow for assuming reporting responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: If a J2 PPLI message (other than J2.0) is received with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence, the C² JU shall assume R² of an IU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a status-indicator based trigger condition within the main flow for assuming reporting responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: If a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received from the FJU for a PU, RU, or other IU, the C² JU shall assume R² of an IU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific message receipt trigger condition within the main flow for assuming reporting responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: If the Geodetic Position Quality in the J2 PPLI message is set to value 0, the C² JU shall assume R² of an IU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a data quality based trigger condition within the main flow for assuming reporting responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: Upon assuming R² of an IU, the C² JU reports it as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG, with Identity reported as Friend.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the primary action taken by the actor after the trigger conditions are met.

evidence_cards.content: The Track Number, Platform and Platform Activity values received in previous PPLI messages shall be reported when assuming R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies data propagation requirements during the transfer of reporting responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: C² JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if local/remote data held indicates any of the following conditions exist: (1) The two tracks have an Identity (ID) difference which constitutes a conflict; (2) The two tracks have different Mode II codes, and the local Mode II code is current; (3) Both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks, i.e., being updated with local positional data; (4) Either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1. Systems shall not inhibit correlation if either track has Strength set to No Statement.

source_locations.location: Section g, Correlation Restrictions, paragraphs (1) through (4)

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines mandatory restrictions on automatic correlation during track processing — a critical constraint that affects whether R² transfer can proceed via automatic correlation in the main flow. These restrictions directly govern system behavior when evaluating track equivalence prior to or during responsibility transfer.

evidence_cards.content: The restrictions do not apply to manual correlation. No other correlation restrictions shall be applied for two tracks which pass the correlation tests specified in paragraph 4.4.4.3.1f.

source_locations.location: Section g, Correlation Restrictions, second sentence

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Clarifies scope of automatic correlation restrictions — manual correlation bypasses them, and no additional restrictions apply beyond those listed if standard correlation tests are passed. This informs alternative flows where operator intervention may override automatic inhibition.

evidence_cards.content: Systems shall have an initialization parameter and an operator selectable capability to inhibit this automatic restriction. Use of this capability will be subject to interface coordination and must be promulgated to all C² IUs. If the use of this capability changes, all participating C² IUs will be informed through voice communication or other communications media. In lieu of specific interface direction, all IUs will restrict automatic correlation by default.

source_locations.location: Section g, Correlation Restrictions, paragraphs (1) and (2), parenthetical notes

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines configurable exceptions to automatic correlation restrictions — operators can override ID or Mode II conflicts under coordinated conditions. This supports alternative flows where human-in-the-loop decisions enable correlation despite default prohibitions.

evidence_cards.content: When a J7.2 message is initiated by own unit and a Drop Track message has not yet been received for the Dropped TN, it shall be retained as a remote track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an initial step in the main flow where the system retains a dropped track as remote pending further messages, establishing part of the interaction sequence.

evidence_cards.content: Data specified below shall be transferred from the Dropped TN to the Retained TN when the correlation is executed; no other Dropped TN data shall be transferred to the Retained TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the core action in the main flow: execution of correlation triggers selective data transfer from Dropped TN to Retained TN.

evidence_cards.content: If the Dropped TN is a local or common local track, the Dropped TN Latitude, Longitude, Course, Speed, Altitude, Altitude Source, TQ, and Strength shall be transferred to the Retained TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details specific kinematic data elements that are transferred during correlation — a concrete step in the main flow’s data-handling sequence.

evidence_cards.content: Retention of identification data is dependent upon whether the ID conflict correlation restriction is inhibited.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Introduces a conditional branch in the main flow based on ID conflict settings, affecting how identification data is handled post-correlation.

evidence_cards.content: If the Identity (ID) of retained TN and Dropped TN are different and the difference would result in automatic acceptance per Table 4.7-2, then Dropped TN ID/IAD and Special Interest Indicator, Platform, Platform Activity, and Specific Type shall be transferred to Retained TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes one path in the main flow for transferring identification data when IDs differ and meet automatic acceptance criteria.

evidence_cards.content: When the Identity of Retained TN and Dropped TN are the same, associated identification data reported for the Retained TN shall be retained.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes another path in the main flow: if identities match, retain existing identification data from Retained TN — part of normal success scenario branching.

evidence_cards.content: Any Dropped TN nonzero Mode I, II, or III IFF/SIF data for a mode for which the Retained TN data is zero shall be transferred.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies transfer rule for IFF/SIF data during correlation — completes the data-transfer steps in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: When the C2 JU transmits a J3.XC1 message to assume R² for a track, it is transmitted at the next opportunity for new tracks when assuming R² or when data changes.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the timing and condition for the C2 JU's transmission of the R² assumption message in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU periodically transmits the J3.XC1 message at 1/8 the basic message rate for realtime tracks and with each NRT track report after assuming R².

source_locations.location: Table 4.4-6, row 2, column 'SURVEILLANCE DATA REPORTING', second paragraph

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the ongoing reporting behavior of the C2 JU after successfully assuming R², which is part of the sustained main flow interaction.

evidence_cards.content: Upon transmitting J3.XC1 to assume R², the C2 JU also transmits difference resolution data at the next opportunity after accepting or rejecting remote data received in a J7.5 (ACT = 1) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a concurrent system action triggered by the R² assumption event, contributing to the complete interaction sequence.

evidence_cards.content: After assuming R² via J3.XC1, the C2 JU transmits data updating information at the next opportunity in response to a J7.1 (ACT = 1) Data Update Request and to a J7.5 (ACT = 2) IFF/SIF Update Request.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details how the C2 JU responds to update requests after becoming the R² holder, completing the post-assumption interaction loop.

evidence_cards.content: A JU assumes R² if it has not received a remote report on a locally held Air or Surface (Maritime) track for approximately 40 seconds, or on a locally held Land (Ground) track for approximately 120 seconds.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines time-based trigger and action for assuming reporting responsibility as part of the main flow sequence.

evidence_cards.content: Upon receiving a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a locally held track, a JU shall assume R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and no remote report has been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies message-triggered assumption of R² with conditions — core step in main flow for transfer scenario.

evidence_cards.content: Immediately prior to assuming R² for an air or surface track after receipt of a Drop Track message, a JU shall test the track for correlation in accordance with paragraphs 4.4.4.3.1f and g, except the test shall be conducted only once.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Adds mandatory pre-assumption validation step in main flow following Drop Track message trigger.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² for a nonreal-time track with TQ field set to value 0 shall assume R² for that track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes data-update-triggered assumption of R² for nonreal-time tracks — variant path within main flow.

evidence_cards.content: A JU receiving a J2 PPLI message (with NPS Indicator set to Inactive, Conditional Radio Silence, or TDS Failure) from a JU that has R² of a locally held track may assume R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and no remote report has been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines conditional assumption of R² triggered by specific PPLI status indicators — alternative success path in main flow.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time Air, Surface (Maritime), or Land (Ground) track upon reception of a remote track report in which remote TQ is greater than the local TQ, or upon reception of a remote track report for the track which contains a TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose STN is greater than the local STN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies exact conditions under which relinquishment occurs — critical counterpart step to assumption in main flow.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² on a track retains the responsibility until it is relinquished in accordance with the above rules or until the track is dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines persistence condition for R² holding — establishes boundary between assumption and relinquishment steps in main flow.

evidence_cards.content: After initially achieving Active status, or after returning to Active status from Inactive status or TDS Failure, C² JUs capable of assuming R² for air, surface, or land tracks shall not transmit air, surface, or land tracks until sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration are performed.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the mandatory sequence of actions (checks, correlation, registration) that must occur before track transmission can begin after a state transition — this is part of the main flow for transferring reporting responsibility when resuming activity.

evidence_cards.content: The minimum wait before reporting air and surface tracks is 12 seconds and for land tracks is 48 seconds.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies concrete time thresholds that constrain the timing of track transmission in the main flow — these are binding operational delays that must be observed during the transfer process.

evidence_cards.content: System design should allow for longer wait times as well as an override in cases where operational necessity requires a shorter wait time or none at all.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes permissible variants to the standard wait-time constraint in the main flow — indicates flexibility under operational necessity, which may constitute alternative flows if triggered by specific conditions.

evidence_cards.content: A JU receiving a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0 (Drop Track Report) on a locally held track shall assume R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific step in the main flow where a JU assumes reporting responsibility triggered by a Drop Track message.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² for a nonreal-time track (TQ field set to value 0) shall assume R² for that track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative or parallel path in the main flow for assuming R² based on local updates of nonreal-time tracks.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ greater than local TQ.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a key interaction step where a JU gives up reporting responsibility based on quality comparison (TQ).

evidence_cards.content: After applying all rules, a JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose Source TN is greater than the local Source TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a secondary condition for relinquishing R² in the main flow when TQ values are tied, using Source TN as the tie-breaker.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which the C² JU has R², the J7.2 Correlation message shall be transmitted with the Response Value (RV) field set to value 1 (Reverse Correlation Not Acceptable), and with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN. The C² JU shall cease reporting the track and transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message on the surveillance TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the main flow step where the C² JU, holding R², rejects reverse correlation by transmitting a J7.2 message with RV=1 and then ceases reporting via a J7.0 Drop Track message, effecting the transfer of reporting responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C² JU has R² and the TNs are different, the J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message shall be transmitted, with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative main flow path where the receiving JU identifies that another JU holds R² (different TNs) and transmits a J7.2 message to formalize the retention/drop decision, supporting the transfer sequence.

evidence_cards.content: If the position or other data in a PPLI meet a system's decorrelation criteria, the PPLI and local track data shall be decorrelated. After decorrelation, the C² JU shall initiate a surveillance track report with locally held data using a new track number.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the core action sequence for the main flow when decorrelation triggers a transfer of reporting responsibility: the C² JU performs decorrelation and then initiates a new surveillance track report, which constitutes assuming R² under a new identifier.

evidence_cards.content: A C² JU shall assume R² of an IU ... in accordance with the reporting rules for a real-time track if the C² JU has correlated local sensor data, when: a. A J2 PPLI message is not received for 40 to 60 seconds, or b. A J2 PPLI message, other than J2.0, is received with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence, or c. A J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received from the FJU for a PU, RU, or other IU, or d. The Geodetic Position Quality in the J2 PPLI message is set to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: These are the specific triggering conditions that cause the C² JU to assume R² — forming the canonical success scenario’s entry point into the main flow. Each condition represents a distinct path into the same outcome: assumption of R² by the C² JU.

evidence_cards.content: A C² JU assuming R² of an IU reports it as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG. The Identity shall be reported as Friend. The Track Number, Platform and Platform Activity values received in previous PPLI messages shall be reported. The PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator shall be reported as value 1, and shall be maintained if another C² JU assumes R² of the IU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the post-assumption reporting behavior required after the C² JU assumes R² — completing the main flow by defining how the newly assumed track is reported and what fields must be preserved or set, ensuring continuity and consistency in the surveillance network.

evidence_cards.content: A JU assumes R² if it has not received a remote report on a locally held Air or Surface (Maritime) track for approximately 40 seconds, or on a locally held Land (Ground) track for approximately 120 seconds.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a time-based trigger and action sequence for assuming reporting responsibility, which is part of the main flow interaction when no remote updates are received.

evidence_cards.content: A JU receiving a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a locally held track shall assume R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a message-triggered step in the main flow where a JU assumes R² upon receipt of a Drop Track message, contingent on local eligibility and absence of remote reports.

evidence_cards.content: Immediately prior to assuming R² for an air or surface track after receipt of a Drop Track message, a JU shall test the track for correlation in accordance with paragraphs 4.4.4.3.1f and g, except the test shall be conducted only once.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a mandatory validation step (correlation test) that must occur before assuming R² after a Drop Track message — part of the canonical success scenario’s procedural sequence.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² for a nonreal-time track with the TQ field set to value 0 shall assume R² for that track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a data-update-triggered assumption of R² for nonreal-time tracks, forming part of the main flow under specific TQ conditions.

evidence_cards.content: A JU receiving a J2 PPLI message (with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive, Conditional Radio Silence, or TDS Failure) from a JU that has R² of a locally held track, may assume R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative but still successful path within the main flow where R² assumption occurs due to status indicators in a J2 PPLI message, subject to eligibility and absence of remote reports.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time Air, Surface (Maritime) or Land (Ground) track upon reception of a remote track report in which remote TQ is greater than the local TQ, or upon reception of a remote track report for the track which contains a TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose STN is greater than the local STN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the canonical relinquishment condition based on TQ/STN comparison — a core step in the main flow where responsibility transfers away from the current holder.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² on a track retains the responsibility until it is relinquished in accordance with the above rules or until the track is dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes persistence of R² until explicit relinquishment or drop — defines the boundary condition for termination of responsibility in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: A JU receiving a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, on a locally held track shall assume R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific step in the main flow where the receiving JU assumes reporting responsibility (R²) upon receipt of a drop track message from the current holder.

evidence_cards.content: After applying all the above rules, a JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose Source TN is greater than the local Source TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative trigger within the main flow sequence that causes the current holder to relinquish R² based on data quality (TQ) and source priority (TN) comparison.

evidence_cards.content: When another JU assumes R² for the point, line, or area, it shall transmit the appropriate FT IND value as previously received in the J3.0 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a core step in the main flow where the new reporting unit actively communicates its assumption of responsibility by transmitting the inherited alert indicator value, ensuring continuity of force tell status across units.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² shall initiate a force tell alert on a reference point, line, or area by setting the FT IND in the J3.0 Reference Point message. All receiving JUs shall accept the alert.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the initial action taken by the current R² holder to propagate alert state — part of the canonical sequence before transfer occurs; relevant context for understanding what is being transferred and how alerts are managed during handoff.

evidence_cards.content: The JU with R² shall terminate a force tell alert by transmitting a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message terminating the alert and setting the FT IND in subsequent J3.0 messages to value 0. All receiving JUs shall terminate the alert upon receipt of the J7.0 (ACT = 4) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes termination behavior that may precede or follow R² transfer; while not directly about assuming R², it defines the protocol for clearing alerts which must be coordinated during responsibility transfer to avoid stale or conflicting states.

evidence_cards.content: When another JU assumes R² for a track, it shall transmit the appropriate EMG IND or FT IND which was received in previous J3.2, J3.3, J3.4, or J3.5 messages.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the immediate action required by the new JU upon assuming reporting responsibility (R²) — transmitting inherited alert indicators — which is part of the canonical success sequence for transferring R².

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² shall initiate/terminate an emergency or force tell alert by setting/clearing the appropriate EMG IND or FT IND in a J7.0 (ACT = 3 or 4) message. Upon receipt, the JU with R² shall set/clear the appropriate EMG IND or FT IND in the J3.2, J3.3, J3.4, or J3.5 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the interaction flow between non-R² and R² JUs during alert state changes, including message types and field updates — relevant to main_flow as it shows coordinated state synchronization after R² transfer context.

evidence_cards.content: Other receiving JUs without R² shall set/clear the appropriate EMG IND or FT IND in their databases upon receipt of the J7.0 (ACT = 3 or 4) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies downstream propagation behavior for non-R² JUs upon receiving alert termination/initiation messages — part of the broader system response sequence following R² assumption or alert modification.

evidence_cards.content: Optionally, alerts may be cleared by reception of a J3.X message with the EMG IND or FT IND set to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Documents an optional alternative path for clearing alerts via J3.X messages — while not part of the primary success flow, it defines a valid variant that affects post-transfer state consistency.

evidence_cards.content: When another JU assumes R² for the point, it shall transmit the appropriate EMG IND or FT IND value as previously received in the J3.5 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Reinforces the requirement for the new R² holder to propagate prior alert indicator values upon assumption — directly supports the main_flow step of inheriting and retransmitting state during R² transfer.

evidence_cards.content: When a C2 JU recognizes that two tracks which are being reported to the interface are eligible for correlation, that JU shall initiate action, either automatically or manually, to resolve the dual designation.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is the initiating action by the primary actor (C2 JU) in the main flow of resolving dual designations, which triggers the transfer of reporting responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: The recognizing JU shall transmit the J7.2 Correlation message requesting all other C2 IUs to perform a correlation of the two tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the core system interaction step — transmitting the J7.2 message — which constitutes the central action in the main flow for transferring R² via decorrelation.

evidence_cards.content: The message identifies the TN to be retained and the TN to be dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the content of the J7.2 message that effectuates the transfer: specifying which track number (TN) assumes R² (retained) and which relinquishes it (dropped).

evidence_cards.content: The receiving IUs shall accept the requested correlation unless certain prespecified conditions exist which require or allow the receiving IU to reject the requested correlation or respond with a reverse correlation request.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the expected system response from receiving units under normal conditions — acceptance — forming part of the canonical success scenario.

evidence_cards.content: Whenever a TN pair is determined to be a dual designation, the recognizing JU shall initiate transmission of the J7.2 message with the Retained TN/Dropped TN selection in accordance with paragraph 4.4.4.3.1j.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the first step in the main flow for transferring reporting responsibility via correlation: initiating the J7.2 message upon dual designation detection.

evidence_cards.content: If the originating C² JU holds R² for the Dropped TN, it shall drop the Dropped TN and transmit the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message after transmitting the J7.2 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies a required follow-on action in the main flow when the originating JU holds reporting responsibility for the dropped track — ensuring relinquishment occurs after correlation initiation.

evidence_cards.content: C² JUs capable of transmitting the J7.2 message shall have an operator selectable capability to deactivate automatic transmission of the message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This constrains the main flow by allowing manual override of automatic transmission, which may affect whether the J7.2 message is sent automatically or requires operator intervention.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs rejecting the requested correlation shall initiate transmission of a J7.2 message with the Retained TN/Dropped TN set as received and RV field set to value 2.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific system action for the rejection path in the correlation transfer flow.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs responding with a reverse correlation shall transmit the J7.2 message with the originally received Retained TN and Dropped TN reversed and the RV field set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific system action for the reverse correlation (assumption) path in the flow.

evidence_cards.content: If the Retained TN is not held but the Dropped TN is held, the correlation request shall be processed by transmitting a reverse correlation with RV set to 1 (if RV=0), transmitting a correlation rejection with RV set to 2 (if RV=1), or executing the correlation using Dropped TN data and Retained TN track number (if RV=3).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details conditional logic within the main flow when the receiving unit holds different track data than expected.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C² JU has R² and the TNs are different, the J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message shall be transmitted, with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative successful path where R² transfer occurs due to dual designation resolution between different Track Numbers, diverging from main flow steps that assume local track initiation or drop.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C² JU has R² and the TNs are the same, the JU receiving the J2 shall accept the PPLI information into its surveillance database and shall disregard the J3 surveillance data on the specified track except when Geodetic Position Quality in the PPLI message is set to value 0, in which case the surveillance track is accepted and the PPLI message shall be discarded.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative successful path where R² remains with the other JU but data fusion occurs based on quality thresholds, diverging from main flow assumption or relinquishment actions.

evidence_cards.content: If a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received on an emergency point, the unit with R² is declared inactive.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative trigger condition for transferring reporting responsibility (R²) specifically for emergency points, diverging from the standard periodic update or manual request flows.

evidence_cards.content: If no periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals on an emergency point, another JU may assume R² for the point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative time-based trigger condition for assuming R² on emergency points when updates are missed, differing from the immediate receipt of a drop message.

evidence_cards.content: A JU assuming R² for an emergency point shall use the same TN Reference and the same value of TN Previously Reported as those reported by the previous reporting unit.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a constraint on the main flow action of assuming R² when triggered by inactivity or emergency status, ensuring continuity of track identification.

evidence_cards.content: A JU assumes R² if it has not received a remote report on a locally held Air or Surface (Maritime) track for approximately 40 seconds.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative successful path for assuming reporting responsibility based on time thresholds for Air/Surface tracks, diverging from the main flow triggered by J7.0 messages.

evidence_cards.content: A JU assumes R² if it has not received a remote report on a locally held Land (Ground) track for approximately 120 seconds.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative successful path for assuming reporting responsibility triggered by local updates of nonreal-time tracks with specific TQ values, diverging from real-time message triggers.

evidence_cards.content: A JU receiving a J2 PPLI message (with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive, Conditional Radio Silence, or TDS Failure) from a JU that has R² of a locally held track, may assume R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative successful path for assuming reporting responsibility triggered by status indicators in J2 PPLI messages, diverging from the standard J7.0 Drop Track trigger.

evidence_cards.content: The J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is transmitted when a JU ceases reporting a track for which it currently has R², except in the following cases: a. evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines specific alternative paths for the termination of reporting responsibility where the standard Drop Track Report message transmission does not occur or is handled differently, directly addressing the 'alternative_flow' slot.

evidence_cards.content: If a J3.4 message containing the TN is not received for two consecutive periodic updates, another JU may assume reporting responsibility for that Track Number.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines an alternative trigger condition (missed periodic updates) that allows divergence from the main flow of assuming R² only after receiving a J7.0 Drop Track message; it represents a still-successful variant path to transfer reporting responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: Any other JU may report what it believes to be the same contact using a different TN, provided it reports only locally derived data in the J3.4 message and does not include data derived solely from remote IU(s) reporting the same contact.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an alternative successful flow where multiple JUs concurrently track the same subsurface contact with different TNs — diverging from the single-R²-holder assumption in the main flow — while maintaining compliance by restricting reported data to local derivations.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² for a nonreal-time track (TQ field set to value 0) shall assume R² for that track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ greater than local TQ.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies an alternative successful relinquishment condition based on TQ comparison, diverging from the main flow’s drop-track-triggered assumption.

evidence_cards.content: After applying all above rules, a JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose Source TN is greater than the local Source TN.

evidence_cards.content: A unit assuming R² for a ballistic missile track need not assume R² for the associated launch point; the unit no longer holding R² on the ballistic missile track may continue to report the launch point in accordance with transmit/receive rules.

evidence_cards.content: When the RV field is set to value 0 it indicates a reverse correlation would be acceptable.

evidence_cards.content: When the RV field is set to value 3, it indicates the correlation was manually initiated and shall be accepted unless certain conditions apply which require rejection (see paragraph 4.7.3.2.c).

evidence_cards.content: If a selection conflict occurs due to OCCs on both the Retained TN and the Dropped TN, the correlation shall be abandoned until the next correlation check.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation request is rejected for a manual correlation, the JU originating the request shall provide an operator alert as a cue to conduct voice coordination.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow path where manual intervention (voice coordination) is triggered upon rejection of a correlation request, diverging from the automatic acceptance or rejection logic.

evidence_cards.content: An operator alert in the event of the rejection of an automatic correlation shall be a system option.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies that for automatic correlations, the alert behavior upon rejection is optional/configurable, representing a variant in the exception handling flow.

evidence_cards.content: After acceptance of a manual correlation the resulting track shall not be the subject of automatic decorrelation processing for a period of 5 minutes.

evidence_cards.content: If the Retained TN is not held but the Dropped TN is held, and the Dropped TN has an OCC with RV set to 0, the C2 JU shall transmit a reverse correlation with RV set to 1.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow path resulting in rejection based on the state of the RV field when the Dropped TN is held.
